alt: The CocoIndex repo tree (main.py, text.py, recursive.rs, README.md) is split along its syntax tree with Tree-sitter, so examples/code_embedding/main.py becomes chunks such as lines 61–88 and 91–106; each chunk is embedded with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 into a row of the code_embeddings table in Postgres; editing process_file re-embeds only its chunk, and the query "where do we embed chunks?" returns main.py lines 61–88, where process_chunk calls embed(chunk.text).

run.note: Index the repo (add -L to keep watching for edits)

run.cmd: python main.py "where do we embed chunks?"
